Multiplying reciprocal phases and setting q=r+1/r gives trace (-q^2+q+7)/D and determinant (q+2)/D, D=5q^2+30q+41. The three strict quadratic Schur inequalities for 5P have manifestly positive numerators for q>=2. The discriminant numerator q^4-22q^3-173q^2-390q-279 has exactly one root q*>2 (Descartes plus signs). For q<q* the modulus is sqrt(d(q)), strictly decreasing; beyond collision, t<0, t' and d' are negative, so (-t+sqrt(t^2-4d))/2 increases. Thus the unique minimizing q and reciprocal r pair, no fixed ratio ceiling and sharp unattained 1/5 supremum are established. Independent exact rational transfer computation for six ratios agrees. Spectral results apply only to homogeneous BDF3 on a fixed two-periodic grid, not arbitrary grids or nonzero spectral parameter.
